name: Defense&Making
detailed_description:
Defense & Making is a tile-based strategy game.

You play as a Demon Lord tasked with designing your own dungeon and defending it from invading enemies.

From deciding the enemy’s path to where traps are placed and which monsters to summon—every decision is entirely up to you.

🎮 Key Features

  • Defense where you design the path
    Go beyond placing units—build the enemy’s route itself using tiles and cards.

  • Randomized tiles and card combinations
    With a different setup each time you'll be crafting new strategies with every run.

  • Combining traps and monsters
    How you place them and in what order will significantly impact how battles play out.

  • Choice-based storytelling
    The stories you encounter aren't just side events—your decisions can shift the fate of the Demon Lord and the world itself.

  • Features available in the full version
    Includes various research systems shop content and up to four full stages of gameplay.

  • Cute art, slightly dark themes
    The visuals are lighthearted but the themes explored in the story may not always be.

Defense & Making doesn’t have a single correct solution.

How you build your dungeon—and how you choose to stop the invaders—is entirely your own.

Instead of chasing the perfect defense we hope you’ll enjoy adapting to new challenges
and finding your own unique way to overcome them.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a dark medieval fantasy world, depicting a society where survival of the fittest, discrimination, and violence are part of everyday life.
Within the game's narrative and worldbuilding, the following mature themes are indirectly or contextually present.

While the game explores the brutality of the world and poses moral questions through these darker themes, it avoids explicit scenes that may cause direct discomfort to players.
However, we kindly ask players who may be sensitive to such settings and tones to take this into consideration before playing.
